canonical_store.rationale: Drive stores original binary source objects and large files; GitHub owns source identity/lifecycle metadata, exact task bindings, and article state. This is an object-store/control-plane split, not two competing business-state authorities.

identity.source_id: Opaque stable identifier minted by the trusted provider; never derive identity from a mutable filename or title.
identity.version_id: Monotonic per-source version plus a raw SHA-256 digest suffix, allocated under GitHub expected-SHA CAS.
identity.resolver: GitHub SOURCE.json maps the logical source/version reference to the exact Drive file ID and revision ID.

version_contract.raw_sha256_semantics: SHA-256 of the exact immutable Drive file payload. That payload is the original source bytes only when storage_policy=RAW_PRESERVED; otherwise it is the permitted excerpt object or metadata manifest. Never label an excerpt/manifest digest as a digest of the full original article.
version_contract.normalized_text_sha256_semantics: SHA-256 of the normalized text actually retained and returned by the provider. For excerpt/metadata policies it covers only that retained excerpt/metadata, not an unretained full source body.

crud.create: Upload a new immutable Drive evidence file whose payload follows storage_policy: original source bytes only for RAW_PRESERVED, permitted excerpts/metadata for METADATA_AND_EXCERPT_ONLY, and a metadata manifest for LINK_ONLY. Read back the exact Drive file/revision and bytes, compute raw_sha256 over the stored Drive payload, then create the GitHub SOURCE.json record and signed effect receipt in one conditional Git commit. Do not admit the source if readback fails.
crud.read: Read GitHub SOURCE.json by source_id/version_id, resolve the exact Drive file_id and revision_id, fetch the stored Drive payload, and verify raw_sha256 over those exact stored bytes, normalized_text_sha256 over the retained text, Drive metadata, and GitHub blob identities. Filename-only matching is never authoritative. Do not imply full-source verification when policy stores only an excerpt or metadata.
crud.update: Create a new Drive file for the new immutable version; never replace old bytes. Its payload must follow the new version's storage_policy and must not copy restricted full text. After exact Drive readback and digest verification, CAS-update the GitHub source record/current-version pointer and append the signed effect receipt. Existing article bindings stay pinned to the old version.
crud.delete: Default DELETE semantics are RETIRE in the GitHub source record: prevent new task bindings while preserving all Drive versions and existing task references. RESTORE is explicit. Physical Drive deletion is forbidden for any source referenced by an article, evidence ledger, receipt, or audit. Legal erasure requires a separately approved history/backup purge.
crud.list_search: List/search GitHub source records by metadata and return exact source_id/version_id references; use the Drive folder only to locate/read the corresponding immutable objects. Do not treat a folder listing as the business registry.

task_binding.exact_coverage: Set of binding.source_ref values must equal the set of all source refs collected from the exact admitted DecisionEnvelope, PrivateResearchBrief, and ResearchPackage artifacts whose digests are pinned in the binding-set envelope.

source_reader.resolver: Financial Provider Action resolves only financial-source:// references through the GitHub source record, reads the exact Drive file/revision, and returns the verified stored payload, retained text, and provenance. It rejects raw external URLs at the durable research-evidence boundary. It must disclose whether the payload is original bytes, permitted excerpt, or metadata manifest.
source_reader.verifier_role: Verify exact stored Drive payload bytes, retained normalized-text digest, source family, retrieval freshness, and task binding; it is not the source CRUD manager.

rights_and_retention.user_supplied_files: Preserve original bytes in the private Drive store unless the user requests otherwise or a legal restriction applies.
rights_and_retention.public_primary_documents: Preserve source bytes when lawful and within provider storage limits; always retain provenance and exact retrieval metadata.
rights_and_retention.news_or_paywalled_material: Do not copy full copyrighted articles by default; retain URL, bibliographic metadata, permitted short excerpts, and retrieval/body digests unless the user has rights or a license.
rights_and_retention.oversized_files: Fail closed when Drive/provider limits are exceeded; do not silently substitute public storage, temporary files, Library, or Notion as canonical storage.
rights_and_retention.publication: Never publish source originals or private research artifacts without explicit authorization.

input_boundary.eligible_sources: Files explicitly supplied for the current Financial task or sources deliberately acquired during its current research.
excluded_by_default: historical Library files not explicitly selected for this task
Notion knowledge pages as raw source originals
input_boundary.new_article_rule: A normal new article is NEW_TASK; it does not inherit prior task attachments or source bindings.
input_boundary.continuation_rule: Only explicit continuation may read the named article STATE and its exact bound source versions.

activation_gates: The canonical Financial GitHub repository is verified PRIVATE because it currently contains private research and article artifacts.
The Google Drive source folder remains PRIVATE and its exact folder ID is verified.
Hosted Financial Provider Action is deployed with least-privilege Google Drive access to this folder and least-privilege GitHub App access to the Financial repository.
Source resolver and source CRUD actions execute through the trusted provider, not direct model-authored GitHub commits or unverified Drive writes.

Positive and negative tests pass for create/read/version-update/retire/restore/list, stale SHA, replay, wrong actor, altered bytes, cross-task scope, Drive revision mismatch, and timeout reconciliation.
A real source file is ingested, reread by exact Drive file/revision, bound to one article task, and independently verified.
Before RESEARCH admission, validate exact equality between canonical source refs in PrivateResearchBrief/ResearchPackage and the current task SOURCE_BINDINGS.json; reject raw URLs and unbound refs.
non_goals: This contract does not create a news-reading-script workflow.
This contract does not treat a URL, filename, chat attachment, or temporary path as a durable source record.
This contract does not make Notion, ChatGPT Library, or temporary files a second raw-source store.
This contract does not retroactively rewrite historical article states or their receipts.

research_admission.exact_coverage_rule: The exact set of source refs collected from DecisionEnvelope, PrivateResearchBrief modules, and all source-bearing fields in ResearchPackage must equal the exact source_ref set in that task's SOURCE_BINDINGS.json.
research_admission.task_scope_rule: Every binding task_id must equal the current article task_id; TASK_ONLY sources cannot be reused by another task; GLOBAL_REUSABLE sources require explicit reusable scope in the source record.
provider_must_reject: raw external URLs used as admitted research evidence refs
financial-source:// references missing from the task SOURCE_BINDINGS.json
version references that do not match the exact Drive file ID, revision ID, and stored-payload digest
duplicate source_ref entries or ambiguous source identity
research_admission.compatibility_boundary: TaskContract.source_refs may contain user-supplied discovery URLs at INTAKE. After source admission, all durable PrivateResearchBrief and ResearchPackage evidence references must use exact financial-source:// references.
